newsitem.title: USA: Service files $50 mln shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: Service files $50 mln shelf registration.

text.p: Service Experts Inc said Friday it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a $50 million shelf registration.

The registration relates to common stock and debt securities to be issued in acquisitions over a two-year period, the company said. The shelf registration is intended to allow Service Experts to access the capital markets in a timely manner as it executes its planned acquisition strategy, the company said.
In August Service Experts obtained net proceeds of $31.3 million through its initial public offering of 2,587,500 shares, the company said.
